2: For the music director; with the flutes. A psalm of David. Hear my words, O Yahweh. Give heed to my sighing.
3: Listen to the sound of my pleading, my king and my God, for to you I pray.
4: O Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will set forth my case to you and I will watch.
5: For you are not a God who desires wickedness. Evil cannot dwell with you.
6: The boastful do not stand before your eyes. You hate all evildoers.
7: You destroy speakers of lies. ⌞A man of bloodshed⌟ and deceit Yahweh abhors.
8: ⌞But as for me⌟, through the abundance of your steadfast love I will enter your house. I will bow down toward ⌞your holy temple⌟ in awe of you.
9: O Yahweh, lead me in your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight before me your way.
10: For there is not anything reliable in his mouth; their inner part is destruction. Their throat is an open grave; with their tongue they speak deceit.
11: Treat them as guilty, O God; let them fall because of their plans. Because of the abundance of their transgressions cast them out, for they have rebelled against you.
12: But let all who take shelter in you rejoice. Let them ever sing for joy, ⌞because⌟ you spread protection over them; And let those who love your name exult in you.
13: For you bless the righteous. O Yahweh, like a shield you surround him with good favor.
